source_message: Landed without Daniel: “Read Daniel's hand edit to Obstacle Set”.
result:
Swept all 52 current PNGs in assets/sprites/generated/. Exact opaque #f8f4e6: 1,357 pixels in 20 sheets (32 sheets have none). Enlarged contact-sheet review and the existing docs/design/evidence/generated_white_inventory.md found no confirmed trapped cream backdrop: these pixels draw white feathers, eggs, farmer and robot highlights, bedding, farmhouse walls, and icon fills. Retained all 1,357; no sprite paint was recolored. The old obstacles.png atlas was retired; its closed-gate cell is now the second 16x16 cell of gate.png and is pixel-identical to the historical atlas before this cleanup.

Closed gate: 52 opaque #bfd470 and 46 opaque #a3c263 pixels were baked grass in gaps between rails or below the gate, not wood shading. Converted those 98 pixels to alpha zero with RGB preserved. Before/after pixel diff against origin/main confirms exactly those 98 alpha changes, no other pixels; atlas remains 32x16 and the open-gate cell is unchanged. Godot import exited 0 and a direct loaded Texture2D read reported a 32x16 texture, 137 transparent pixels in the closed cell, and zero opaque grass pixels. The read-only light-pixel scan still covers 52 sheets and finds 12 with edge-adjacent intentional light pixels. The display visual-regression runner could not initialize X11/Wayland in this sandbox, so no screenshot verdict is claimed. No new art was generated or provenance changed.
